app_document_description: MyTuums is the social media platform built for gamers.
auth_login_subtitle: Log in to your MyTuums account using your username or email
auth_register_subtitle: Join MyTuums with a unique username and password
auth_field_bio_placeholder: A line or two about you.
auth_oauth_account_not_linked: An account with this email address already exists. Sign in with your password, then connect this provider from your account settings.
auth_oauth_already_linked: That account is already connected to a different MyTuums user.
auth_oauth_no_email: That provider didn't share an email address, which we need to create your account.
auth_oauth_email_mismatch: That account uses a different email address than the one on your MyTuums account.
auth_oauth_signup_disabled: New accounts from this provider aren't accepted right now.
auth_oauth_expired: That sign-in request expired. Please try again.
auth_oauth_failed: That sign-in didn't complete. Please try again.
auth_forgot_subtitle: Enter your account email and we'll send you a reset link.
auth_forgot_check_email_hint: If that address belongs to a MyTuums account, we've sent a reset link. It expires in one hour.
auth_reset_subtitle: Choose a new password for your account.
auth_reset_success_hint: Your password has been changed. Sign in with your new password.
auth_reset_invalid_title: This link is invalid or expired
auth_reset_invalid_hint: Reset links are single-use and expire after one hour. Request a new one to continue.
validation_username_length: Username must be between 3 and 20 characters long.
validation_username_characters: Username can only contain letters, numbers, underscores, and hyphens.
validation_email_invalid: Please enter a valid email address.
validation_password_length: Password must be at least 8 characters long.
validation_identifier_required: Please enter your username or email address.
validation_dob_invalid: Please enter a valid date of birth.
validation_dob_age: You must be at least 15 years old to create an account.
validation_bio_length: Your bio must be 160 characters or fewer.
validation_image_managed: Profile images are set by uploading a file.
validation_image_type: That image format isn't supported. Use a PNG, JPEG or WebP.
validation_image_unreadable: That file doesn't look like an image.
welcome_subtitle: One last step — choose the @name people will find you by.
welcome_handle_hint: 3 to 20 characters. Letters, numbers, underscores and hyphens.
welcome_dob_subtitle: You must be at least 15 years old to use MyTuums.
welcome_dob_hint: You must be at least 15 years old.
welcome_2fa_subtitle: Add a second step to your sign-in. You can always do this later.
twofa_section_on: On. You'll be asked for a code when you sign in.
twofa_section_off: Off. Add a second step to protect your account.
twofa_scan_hint: Scan this with your authenticator app, then enter the code it shows.
twofa_backup_codes_hint: Save these somewhere safe. Each one works once, and this is the only time they're shown.
twofa_challenge_totp_subtitle: Enter the code from your authenticator app.
twofa_challenge_email_subtitle: Enter the code we emailed you.
twofa_challenge_backup_subtitle: Enter one of your backup codes.
twofa_trust_device: Don't ask again on this device for 30 days
passkey_section_description: Sign in with your fingerprint, face or security key instead of a password.
settings_subtitle: Manage how you sign in to MyTuums.
settings_profile_description: This is what other people see.
settings_avatar_hint: Square works best. PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 5 MB.
settings_banner_hint: Wide and short. PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 8 MB.
settings_handle_warning: Changing this breaks every existing link to your profile, and frees your old handle for someone else to take.
settings_password_description: Change the password you sign in with.
settings_password_revoke_hint: Changing your password signs you out everywhere else.
settings_prefs_description: Defaults for theme and language on your account.
settings_prefs_hint: These apply on any device you have not already chosen on. The switchers in the header and footer still override them here.
settings_linked_description: Connect a provider to sign in with it.
settings_linked_last_method: This is your only way to sign in.
settings_sign_out_description: Sign out of MyTuums on this device.
feed_signed_out_cta: Log in to post and like.
feed_empty_following: Nothing here yet — you're not following anyone who's posted.
feed_empty: No posts yet. Be the first to post something.
post_placeholder: Share a gaming update, clip, or tournament result...
post_publish_error: Could not publish your post. Please try again.
post_not_found_hint: This post may have been deleted, or the link may be wrong.
reply_publish_error: Could not publish your reply. Please try again.
reply_empty: No replies yet. Be the first to reply.
thread_truncated: This conversation continues above the {count} replies shown.
profile_not_found: There's nobody here. This handle isn't taken.
notfound_body: This page doesn't exist or has moved.
